routeSafety.verdict: Eligible only for a bounded hosting-credential denial canary, subject to future explicit rotation authorization; not an authenticated HTTP-200 health probe.
routeSafety.knownExecutionPath: Production config validation, exact host/origin guard, then tester auth gate, then health response. Health dispatch returns before secret initialization or DB/provider business adapters.

immutableHostExpectedAppResponseWithVali.reason: Immutable deployment origin differs from the mandatory canonical origin, so the host guard fails before tester authentication.

configInvalidResponse.meaning: Fail-closed configuration response; not healthy or successful rotation validation.

canonicalOriginWithoutAppBearerExpectedR.scope: Source prediction only; canonical URL alias/DNS and actual configuration were not queried.

routeSafety.operationalSideEffects: Each app invocation may emit one or two schema-checked metadata events through console.warn into Vercel Runtime Logs. This is an operational log write; no zero-side-effect claim is made. Hosting access logs/usage are also possible.
routeSafety.noBearerBoundary: Omitting Authorization prevents the Microsoft JWKS/tester verifier call. The fixed /api/health path cannot select Teams, Resend, CRM proof, cron, canary business or diagnostic DB routes.
routeSafety.positiveHealthBlocker: HTTP-200 health requires the source-pinned canonical origin plus an approved real Entra tester bearer; verifying that bearer may read Microsoft JWKS. Neither app authentication nor canonical alias verification is included in this four-GET credential plan.
routeSafety.healthSummaryLimit: The status body is derived from configuration, not live provider probes. LIVE_VERIFIED/HEALTHY labels in that body alone cannot establish provider availability.
routeSafety.reviewLimit: Static first-party route/called-dependency review, not runtime execution, a dependency-package audit or a fresh production-state attestation.

requestRequirements: Exactly the fixed HTTPS URL, no arbitrary URL/body/query token.
